name: Lily Lucier
bio: Hi! My name is Lily Lucier and I am a senior at Barrington High School! I am the Vice President of Barrington's FBLA chapter, and I am very excited to be the Co-President of RI FBLA! This year, I want to make sure that all of our chapters stay informed and engaged. One of my goals is to make sure all members are well prepared for SLC by increasing communication with members and local chapters!
